patch.value: SDK-capability enhancement: idempotent sync, preflight, bidirectional status mapping, export updates

Drastically enhance pm-linear toward domain-appropriate max against pm-cli SDK 2026.5.31.

Value: make Linear<->pm sync production-grade and idempotent so re-running import updates existing items instead of duplicating, add a preflight guard before any mutating Linear call, add assignee/label filters, make the exporter update (not just create) Linear issues, and add bidirectional status mapping + HTTP robustness (timeout, rate-limit backoff).

Capabilities before: commands, schema, importers, services (services declared but unused). 
Capabilities after (target): commands, schema, importers, preflight (drop unused services).

Acceptance criteria:
- Re-import updates existing pm items matched on linear_id provenance (no duplicates); evidence via fixtures.
- preflight capability validates LINEAR_API_KEY + API reachability before mutating commands with clear failure_hints.
- assignee + label filters on import (GraphQL filter clauses).
- exporter creates AND updates Linear issues (idempotent on stored linear id), with --dry-run.
- bidirectional status map (pm-status -> Linear state) applied on export push.
- linearRequest gains timeout + 429/rate-limit backoff retry.
- All gates green; functional fixtures + dry-run scratch workspace; exit codes verified.
